svg.title: The lights of Arles: 90 days of GitHub contributions
svg.desc: A painted night river. Along the far shore, one light per day with at least one contribution over the last 90 observed days; each reflection is as long as that day’s contribution count. 277 contributions over 365 days, 241 over the last 90, as of 2026-11-19.
svg.text: 277 contributions in 365 days · 241 in the last 90 · each light is a day, its reflection that day’s contributions
